page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Page number 371 at the top right. Foot: gathering signature "Aa 2" at the left, catchword "di-" at the right.

main_text.p: matis consensum. Confer, & compone, si vales.

1. Diuinam Christi naturam passam non esse. 2. Patrem, Filium, & Spiritum sanctum unum Deum omnipotentem. 3. Unum essentia, Trinum personis. 4. Fi-lium æqualem in omnibus Patri, ex Patre genitum, Deum de Deo. 5. Spiritum san-ctum in omnibus æqualem Patri, & Filio ex Patre, & Filio, vel per Filium proce-dentem.
main_text.head: Quid Reformati ?
main_text.p: 1. Lutherus de Concilijs parte 2. Diui-nam in Christo naturam passam esse. Andreas Musculus commendat librum Lutheri, quo ex professo scribit, Diuinam in Christo natu-ram passam, & mortuam esse: & libro de concordia discipulorum Lutheri testimonijs probat, illum semper sensisse, ac docuisse, quod Christi Diuinitas in cruce passa sit. Iacobus Andreæ Thesi 156. fatetur, pati, & mori nomine & re pertinere ad Diuinitatem. Stephanus Gerlachius contra Bufæum con-cisè asserit, veras esse has propositiones, Diui-nitas est nata, crucifixa, mortua.
2. Valentinus Gentilis in suis Prothe-sibus Patrem, Filium, & Spiritum sanctum tres Deos esse æternos, asserit, essentiali numero

page.notes: Left edge fragments and the faint marks along the left border are show-through or the edge of the neighbouring page, so they are left out. The rule-like marks after "non", "Filio" and "Patre" are printer's line-end ornaments, not text. Long s is normalised to plain s in "consensum" and "est"; u/v is normalised as the spelling rule requires. No doubtful readings.
